rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Django-based Firebase MCP server that integrates Firebase Admin SDK capabilities into Django applications, providing tools for Firebase Authentication (token verification, custom token creation, user management), Firestore database operations (document CRUD, collection queries), and Cloud Storage file management. Built by Highpolar Softwares, it offers both HTTP and stdio transport options with a custom Django management command for server execution, making it valuable for Django developers who need to expose Firebase backend services to AI assistants for user management, data operations, and file handling workflows without leaving their Django environment.
